Times UTC. *_ha of radar: radar-dark area inside the basin polygon (dark-pixel rule), never lake area; lake_lo/lake_hi: shore band.

orbit_note.098A: most trustworthy for area (0.5% of the basin in layover)
orbit_note.135D: usable (3.0% in layover); holds the look of 17 Jul during the drainage
orbit_note.034D: not usable for area (14.2% in layover, weak water contrast)
